description: Banco Galicia is the largest private-sector commercial bank in Argentina. Founded in 1905, the bank offers financial services to over nine million individual and corporate customers. It offers various savings accounts, personal and mortgage loans, debit and credit cards, security boxes, asset management, and investment services, as well as telephone, online, and SMS banking services. Banco Galicia also provides car, home, life, health, personal accident, combined family, robbery and extended warranty, trade, property, retirement, and other insurance services. It operates through a network of 423 bank branches and an electronic banking center.
summary: Banco Galicia is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 22.21 billion (2020)and Total Assests: ARS 947.56 billion (2020)

description: Founded in 1891, Banco de la Nacion Argentina provides commercial banking services in the country. With around 18,000 employees, the bank is headquartered in Buenos Aires. BNA operates about 630 branches and 2,050 ATMs nationwide, 13 overseas branches in nine countries (Bolivia, Brazil, USA, Chile, Spain, Panama, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Venezuela), as well as representative offices in Brazil, Venezuela, and China. It was established in October 1891.
summary: Banco de la Nacion Argentina (BNA) is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: USD 408 million (2016)and Total Assests: USD 31.31 billion (2016)

description: Banco Marco received a license to operate as one of the commercial banks in Argentina in 1988. It provides various financial products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Argentina. The bank is headquartered in Buenos Aires and currently employs around 8,500 individuals. It operates through a network of 463 branches, 1,578 ATMs, 960 self-service terminals, and service points. The company was incorporated in 1966.
summary: Banco Macro is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 30.27 billion (2020)and Total Assests: ARS 765.8 billion (3/2021)

description: Established in 1886, Banco Hipotecario offers banking and related financial services to individuals, small and medium enterprises, and corporations in Argentina. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, the bank focuses on real estate lending. It currently employs around 1,605 staff.
summary: Banco Hipotecario is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 916.5 million (2020)and Total Assests: ARS 141.4 billion (3/2021)

description: Banco Patagonia was incorporated in 1976. The bank operates a network of 179 branches, 17 client service centers, and four agencies, as well as 568 ATMs and 357 self-service terminals. It is headquartered in Buenos Aires, with around 3,200 employees.
summary: Banco Patagonia is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 10.48 billion (2020)and Total Assests: ARS 301.2 billion (2020)

description: Incorporated in 1822, Banco de la Provincia operates as a public bank. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, Banco Provincia is one of the top five banks in Argentina. It offers current and savings accounts, loans, credit and debit cards, investments, mutual funds, lines of credit, foreign trade, SME banking, agricultural banking, and other services. The bank currently employs around 10,500 individuals and operates through a network of 400 branches.
summary: Banco de la Provincia is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 7.59 billion (2019)and Total Assests: ARS 931.7 billion (9/2020)

description: Incorporated in 1886, Banco Santander Rio is indirectly controlled by Banco Santander SA. The bank provides various financial products and services to individual and business customers, as well as small and medium-sized enterprises in Argentina. It also offers life and casualty insurance products. The bank owns several subsidiaries, including Santander Rio Valores SA. Formerly known as Banco Rio de la Plata, Banco Santander Rio is headquartered in Buenos Aires. It operates 464 branches and employs around 7,900 staff.
summary: Banco Santander Rio is one of the top banks in Argentina with Net Income: ARS 30.27 billion (2020)and Total Assests: ARS 765.8 billion (3/2021)
